East on US-26 from
intersection with Canton St

Scenic Bikeway route starts at entrance to Kam Wah
Chung State Heritage Site. Free overnight parking at
the Kam Wah Chung Interpretive Center. Cyclists
should check in with the park ranger to ensure that
their vehicle is in a state-owned parking spot.
Austin Junction - restaurant, store, bike camping

Bates State Park – hiker/biker camping, water. No
shower. No drinking water between Bates State
Park and Long Creek (mile 83)! Bring water filter
and/or carry extra water.

Dayville - restaurant, store, water, bicyclist camping in
church
Mt. Vernon - restaurant, store, cycling hostel

Route ends at Kam Wah
Chung State Heritage Site
